channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-35273 — Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools
item.description: Threat Signal 91. Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to obtain takeover of PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools.

item.title: CVE-2015-3306 — ProFTPD ProFTPD
item.description: Threat Signal 90. ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

item.title: CVE-2023-22894 — Strapi Strapi
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-3199 — ONLYOFFICE Docs
item.description: Threat Signal 74. ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-1761 — Microsoft Word
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Word contains a memory corruption vulnerability which when exploited could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-53690 — Sitecore Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Sitecore Experience Manager (XM), Experience Platform (XP), Experience Commerce (XC), and Managed Cloud contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability involving the use of default machine keys. This flaw allows attackers to exploit exposed ASP.NET machine keys to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-5477 — ISC BIND
item.description: Threat Signal 85. ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

item.title: CVE-2016-3081 — Apache Struts
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-0300 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the User-ID Authentication Portal (aka Captive Portal) service that can allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls by sending specially crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2025-14611 — Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Gladinet CentreStack and TrioFox contain a hardcoded cryptographic keys vulnerability for their implementation of the AES cryptoscheme. This vulnerability degrades security for public exposed endpoints that may make use of it and may offer arbitrary local file inclusion when provided a specially crafted request without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2025-58034 — Fortinet FortiWeb
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Fortinet FortiWeb contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code on the underlying system via crafted HTTP requests or CLI commands.

item.title: CVE-2021-43226 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System Driver contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow a local, privileged attacker to bypass certain security mechanisms.

item.title: CVE-2025-32463 — Sudo Sudo
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Sudo contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow local attacker to leverage sudo’s -R (--chroot) option to run arbitrary commands as root, even if they are not listed in the sudoers file.

item.title: CVE-2007-0671 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that can be exploited when a specially crafted Excel file is opened. This malicious file could be delivered as an email attachment or hosted on a malicious website. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability by creating a specially crafted Excel file, which, when opened, allowing an attacker to execute remote code on the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2025-24472 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to gain super-admin privileges via crafted CSF proxy requests.

item.title: CVE-2025-0411 — 7-Zip 7-Zip
item.description: Threat Signal 67. 7-Zip contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bypass the Mark-of-the-Web security feature to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2024-37383 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 67. RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the handling of SVG animate attributes that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

item.title: CVE-2020-13965 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Roundcube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to manipulate data via a malicious XML attachment.

item.title: CVE-2024-26169 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Service contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows a local attacker with user permissions to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-30051 — Microsoft DWM Core Library
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft DWM Core Library contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-29988 — Microsoft SmartScreen Prompt
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft SmartScreen Prompt contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the Mark of the Web (MotW) feature. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-38831 and CVE-2024-21412 to execute a malicious file.

item.title: CVE-2023-6549 — Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

item.title: CVE-2023-41064 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in ImageIO when processing a maliciously crafted image, which may lead to code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2023-41061.

item.title: CVE-2023-35081 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that enables an authenticated administrator to perform malicious file writes to the EPMM server. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-35078 to bypass authentication and ACLs restrictions (if applicable).

item.title: CVE-2018-19321 — GIGABYTE Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 67. The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2018-19320 — GIGABYTE Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 67. The GDrv low-level driver in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II exposes ring0 memcpy-like functionality that could allow a local attacker to take complete control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2013-2094 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Linux kernel fails to check all 64 bits of attr.config passed by user space, resulting to out-of-bounds access of the perf_swevent_enabled array in sw_perf_event_destroy(). Explotation allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2018-13374 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC contain an improper access control vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain the LDAP server login credentials configured in FortiGate by pointing a LDAP server connectivity test request to a rogue LDAP server.

item.title: CVE-2022-21971 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Windows Runtime contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2009-0557 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Office contains an object record corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Excel file with a malformed record object.

item.title: CVE-2015-2425 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2014-4123 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to gain privileges via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2014-4077 — Microsoft Input Method Editor (IME) Japanese
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Input Method Editor (IME) Japanese is a keyboard with Japanese characters that can be enabled on Windows systems as it is included by default (with the default set as disabled). IME Japanese contains an unspecified vulnerability when IMJPDCT.EXE (IME for Japanese) is installed which allows attackers to bypass a sandbox and perform privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2019-1385 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows AppX Deployment Extensions improperly performs privilege management, resulting in access to system files.

item.title: CVE-2022-24521 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2020-2509 — QNAP QNAP Network-Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 67. QNAP NAS devices contain a command injection vulnerability which could allow attackers to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-8406 — Microsoft DirectX Graphics Kernel (DXGKRNL)
item.description: Threat Signal 67. An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when the DirectX Graphics Kernel (DXGKRNL) driver improperly handles objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2018-8405 — Microsoft DirectX Graphics Kernel (DXGKRNL)
item.description: Threat Signal 67. An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when the DirectX Graphics Kernel (DXGKRNL) driver improperly handles objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2012-2539 — Microsoft Word
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Word allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via crafted RTF data.

item.title: CVE-2018-8373 — Microsoft Internet Explorer Scripting Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 67. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the scripting engine handles objects in memory in Internet Explorer.

item.title: CVE-2019-1315 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows Error Reporting manager improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could overwrite a targeted file leading to an elevated status.

item.title: CVE-2019-1069 — Microsoft Task Scheduler
item.description: Threat Signal 67. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in the way the Task Scheduler Service validates certain file operations.

item.title: CVE-2019-1064 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppXSVC improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2019-0543 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows improperly handles authentication requests. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2017-6737 — Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software
item.description: Threat Signal 67. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code.

item.title: CVE-2015-1642 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted document.

item.title: CVE-2021-27102 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a local web service call.

item.title: CVE-2019-5591 — Fortinet FortiOS
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Fortinet FortiOS contains a default configuration vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker on the same subnet to intercept sensitive information by impersonating the Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) server.

item.title: CVE-2016-0167 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation via a crafted application

item.title: CVE-2021-31955 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Windows Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for information disclosure. Successful exploitation allows attackers to read the contents of kernel memory from a user-mode process.
